# dsh-douyin-subagent

> A "scroll Douyin" plugin for DSH — modeled on
> dsh-bili-subagent. At valley hours it sends a suba

gent to browse
> Douyin: search videos, read details, go through the comments, pick what is worth wa

tching, and report back.
> The hard part (Douyin APIs, signing, login state) is provided by
> yunsur
/douyin-mcp — 133 tools over plain HTTP.
English | 中文
## What you get
- **15 tools**: `dy_status` / `dy_config` / `dy_login` / `dy_search` / `dy_video` / `dy_comments` /
`dy_comment` / `dy_publish` / `dy_notices` / `dy_inbox` / `dy_messages` / `dy_dm` / `dy_scan` / `dy_

tools` / `dy_mcp`
- **Valley-time timer**: 13:00–15:00 and 19:00–10:00 (next day), weekends count as

valley all day.
At the appointed time it hands a trigger to the target session; the agent then runs

`dy_scan` itself.
`perDay` rounds per day, at least `gapMin` minutes apart.
- **Charter** `prompts/

duty.md` (overridable at `$DSH_HOME/douyin-duty/duty.md`): verify login, search 2–3 keyword
variants

, read details and comments, pick at most N, "better nothing than junk", never guess.
- **Reports**
at `$DSH_HOME/douyin-duty/out/<date>.md`.
## Requirements
| piece | what |

| DSH | a profile that can install plugins (this is a bundle plugin, `dsh.bundle` declared) |
| `dou
yin-mcp-windows-amd64.exe` | prebuilt binary from yunsur/douyin-mcp releases — **pinned to `v0.1.0`*

*, see Version pinning. The plugin spawns it on `:18080`; you point `mcpExe` at it |
| a Chromium-ba
sed browser (Edge/Chrome) | only for login + publishing; the plugin drives it over CDP on port 9222

with a dedicated `--user-data-dir` |
| a Douyin account | log in once through the browser, export co

ted `--user-data-dir` |
| a Douyin account | log in once through the browser, export cookies, done |
## Version pinning
The plugin treats `douyin-mcp` as an **external binary**, so an upstream change would otherwise brea

k it
silently — with an error that looks like anything but "wrong version". It is therefore pinned t

o the exact
build that has been tested:

| release | `yunsur/douyin-mcp` `v0.1.0` (2026-10-07) |
| asset | `douyin-mcp-windows-amd64.exe` |

Before spawning the server (and again after `initialize`, where `serverInfo` is available) the plugi

the binary and compares it with this table. A mismatch is **reported, not swallowed** — `dy

`dy_status` reports the same verdict as `mcp.version`: `{level: ok|warn|error|off, tested, detected,
reports the same verdict as `mcp.version`: `{level: ok|warn|error|off, tested, detected, message}`.
Two things worth knowing:
- **`serverInfo.version` is not a release number.** The upstream binary hardcodes `"version": "1.0.0

"` in
`initialize` regardless of the tag it was built from, so the real lock is the **SHA-256**; the

version string
is only a secondary signal (a changed `serverInfo` usually means the interface moved

too).
- **Only the Windows asset is hashed.** On other platforms the check falls back to comparing
`serverInfo.version` and reports `level: "warn"` ("unverifiable") rather than claiming a match.
Override with `mcpVersionCheck`:
| value | behaviour |

| `strict` (default) | different binary ⇒ error; `dy_*` refuse to run |
| `warn` | different binary

⇒ logged and shown in `dy_status`; tools still run |
| `off` | no check at all (a mismatch will then
fail wherever upstream changed) |
Re-testing a newer upstream release is a deliberate step: bump `TESTED_MCP` in `lib/mcpVersion.mjs`,

run a
`dy_scan` + `dy_comments` round, then update this table.

## 依赖
| 件 | 说明 |

| DSH | 能装插件（本插件声明了 `dsh.bundle`） |
| `douyin-mcp-windows-amd64.exe` | yunsur/douyin-mcp releases 的预

编译版，**锁在 `v0.1.0`**（见下面「版本锁定」）；插件会在 `:18080` 拉起它，路径用 `mcpExe` 配 |
| Chromium 系浏览器（Edge/Chrome） | 只用来

登录和发布；插件用独立的 `--user-data-dir` 通过 CDP 驱动它 |
| 抖音账号 | 在受控浏览器里扫一次码，导出 cookie 即可 |
## 注意与边界

- **MCP 只监听本机**：插件启动它时用每次安装随机生成的 Bearer token，绑在 `127.0.0.1`。
- **发布**：MCP 的发布工具需要 TICKET/TS_SIGN/PR

IVATE_KEY 这类材料，多数账号拿不到；实际发布走创作者中心网页
<https://creator.douyin.com/creator-micro/content/upload>，`vendo

r/douyin-tools/` 里有配套的 CDP 脚本。
两个容易踩的点：① 页面顶部只有「发布视频 / 发布图文 / 发布全景视频 / 发布文章」四个 tab 和「上传视频 / 上传图文」
按钮

，**素材上传之前整页根本没有「发布」按钮**（实测 `querySelectorAll('button')` 里就没有它，只有最外层导航里的
「作品发布」），选文件之前去找它当然找不到；② 素材框是

`input[type=file]`（视频框 `accept=video/*`、图文框 `accept=image/...`），用 DOM 的
`setFileInputFiles` 塞文件比模拟点

put[type=file]`（视频框 `accept=video/*`、图文框 `accept=image/...`），用 DOM 的
`setFileInputFiles` 塞文件比模拟点击可靠。

- **`check_login_status` 会误报**：判断登录看 `get_my_profile` 的 `status_code === 0`（`dy_status` 已经替你处理）。
- *

*cookie 会过期**：受控浏览器还登着的时候，`dy_login { action: "save" }` 重新导一次。
- **新号风控严**：评论、发布小量、隔开。
- 与抖音/字节跳动无关；
个人使用，遵守对方条款、尊重别人隐私。看评论可以，别批量抓。

evidence.fact: README列出一组抖音相关工具，涵盖状态、搜索、视频与评论等类别。
README工具列表还包括账户交互类别，因此该集成并非仅限只读浏览。

limitations: 文档列出的工具范围包含账户交互能力；使用前应审阅权限和操作范围，不能据此推断安全性。
依赖外部连接组件和已登录的抖音账户；此批模型输入标记为截断。
本摘要仅做功能类别描述，不列出账户操作步骤或具体调用方式。
